messages:
Priya: kicking off RC v1.3.0 build from release/1.3 at commit `f7e4b2a` — aiming for 09:00 UTC quiet window. Requesting quick sanity and a short canary watch.
Dan: ack, I'll run canary smoke + core flows and be on standby for the push.
ci-bot: Pipeline triggered: build rc-v1.3.0 from `f7e4b2a`. Unit tests: 1145 passed, 3 flaky (rerun queued). Integration: ok. Artifact: sha c3b9a7f.
Lucas: saw flaky `auth/refresh_token` in integ rerun, passed second attempt — leaving note to investigate retry vs timeout.
Priya: tagging artifact and staging plan: pin `rc-v1.3.0` -> artifact c3b9a7f. Staging promote now, 5% canary traffic. Keep max-rollout-surge 8%.
deploybot: Promotion to staging requested: `/deploy promote --artifact c3b9a7f --to staging --tag rc-v1.3.0`
deploybot: Staging deploy succeeded. Canary subset: 5% traffic, 2/2 instances warm per region.
Dan: quick telemetry: baseline p95 unchanged, p99 +90ms in region eu-west-1 during warmup, no error spike. Pinpointing to model coldstart on embed cache.
Lucas: enabling KV prewarm during prod promo to reduce tail. Adding temporary env var `KV_PREWARM=true` for rollout.
Priya: decision tree: proceed to prod promo at 09:00 UTC if nothing crosses thresholds in next 25m. Alerts that cause abort: error-rate delta >0.3% sustained 3m OR p99 latency +150ms sustained 3m OR any increase in 5xx. Kill-switch: manual rollback + mute traffic route.
Priya: Rollback quick commands (pinned):
`/deploy rollback --to-artifact 1.2.9-b2a33c --reason "rc-v1.3.0 regression"`
Or emergency route cut: `/infra route shift --service api --to stable-1.2.9 --immediate`
ci-bot: Regression suite scheduled to run on staging: smoke + user-critical flows. ETA 10m.
deploybot: Promo window reminder scheduled for 09:00 UTC. When ready run: `/deploy promote --artifact c3b9a7f --to prod --tag rc-v1.3.0`
Dan: I'll monitor dashboards and keep a 15m post-promo watch. Lucas will handle verification of embedding correctness.
Priya: release notes draft at docs/releases/v1.3.0.md — please add any public-facing changes by 08:35 UTC. Also note migration step for client SDK: bump minor.
prod-watch: pre-promo checklist: 1) alarms set for errors/p99/5xx 2) rollout surge = 8% 3) KV_PREWARM=true 4) canary traffic 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 12m if healthy.
ci-bot: Regression suite: PASS on staging. All critical flows green.
deploybot: Prod promote requested by Priya at 09:00 UTC: `/deploy promote --artifact c3b9a7f --to prod --tag rc-v1.3.0`
deploybot: Rolling deploy in progress: regions: us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1. Max surge 8%.
deploybot: Rolling deploy complete: all regions healthy, traffic ramp finished.
Dan: live telemetry: p50/p95 stable, p99 back to baseline; no error-rate increase. Embedding checks: vector similarity smoke OK.
Lucas: spot-check client SDK integration — OK. Will follow-up with TICKET-1582 for flaky auth test.
Priya: closing out: rc-v1.3.0 promoted to prod, release notes published. If anyone sees anything odd, follow rollback commands above and @prod-watch. Thanks!
